meta.name: add-clidash
meta.description: Add clidash — a zero-dependency, read-only web dashboard that derives its tabs and tables at runtime from any CLI that lists resources as JSON. Ships pre-wired for NanoClaw's ncl CLI (agent groups, sessions, channels, users, roles), plus message-activity charts, a log tail, and a read-only file viewer for group skills/CLAUDE.md/profiles.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将任意 JSON 输出 CLI 转为实时 Web 仪表盘
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你有输出 JSON 的 CLI 工具，想快速生成 Web 仪表盘
copy.tagline_en: Turn any JSON-output CLI into a live web dashboard
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have a CLI that outputs JSON and want a quick web dashboard

howto.what: 装好后会跑起一个只读网页面板:它读取能输出 JSON 的 CLI(如 ncl),在运行时自动为每个资源生成标签页和表格,并显示 Agents 概览、活动图表、日志尾部与文件查看器。
howto.when: 当你运行 /add-clidash,或想给能列出 JSON 资源的命令行工具(如 ncl)加一个只读网页面板时触发。

say.text: 帮我安装 clidash,把 tools/clidash 复制到项目里
say.note: 只复制工具目录,不改 NanoClaw 源码

say.text: 启动 clidash,确认 ncl 的资源发现是否正常
怎么让 clidash 在我的 tailnet 上访问?
say.note: 把 bind 设为私有 IP,不要用公网

howto.what_en: Installs a small read-only web dashboard. Point it at any CLI that lists resources as JSON (ncl, docker, kubectl) and it builds tabs and tables at runtime; adds Agents overview, activity charts, log tail, and a file viewer.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you run /add-clidash, or want a read-only web dashboard over a CLI that lists JSON resources, such as the ncl CLI.

say_en.text: Install clidash and copy tools/clidash into my project
say_en.note: Copies only the tool dir; NanoClaw src is untouched.

say_en.text: Start clidash and check that ncl resource discovery works
How do I reach clidash from another device on my tailnet?
say_en.note: Set BIND to a private IP; never a public interface.
